Speaking at a memorial ceremony, Katz stated that Israel will not retreat from its red line in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the area is demilitarized. He also addressed the campaign against Iran, asserting that Iran's nuclear threat has been eliminated and that further action will be taken if necessary.
headlines.title_he: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"

headlines.title: מקרון באמירה מקוממת: "חמאס מעולם לא פעל בגדה המערבית"

He added that the legitimate right of the Palestinian people to exist must be respected. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu responded, calling the statement an unimaginable absurdity, noting a French citizen was recently killed by a Hamas terrorist in the West Bank. Izankot also commented that the statement was extremely detached from reality on the ground.

headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron, who was murdered in a shooting attack near Neve Tzuf, was laid to rest. Family, friends, and residents attended the funeral. His 16-year-old son, Yoav, who was with him during the attack, bid farewell, saying, "Thank you for giving me life." His wife, Merav, described him as a very involved father, and his sister, Ruti, called him a pleasant, intelligent, and humble person.

headlines.title: נתנאל שקרון הוא הנרצח בפיגוע במעיין בבנימין; המחבל נלכד בבית חולים ברמאללה
headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron was killed in an attack near a spring in Benjamin, and the perpetrator was apprehended in a Ramallah hospital. A gunman opened fire on people at the spring near Neve Tzuf. Natanel Shkaron, a father of six from Eli, was critically injured and later pronounced dead. After an extensive manhunt, the gunman was arrested in a hospital in Ramallah, having been wounded by Israeli forces during the pursuit. Shortly after, a second attacker, who attempted a ramming attack in the northern West Bank, was killed.
